items.title: Flatness is the same over the base and over an etale cover
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that flatness of a module over the base is equivalent to flatness over an etale cover, pointwise and globally (statement lines 123-135, tag 05FQ-adjacent). One implication is composition with the flat etale morphism, while the converse uses that the pullback of the module to the product is flat over the etale scheme by base change and that the diagonal of an etale morphism is an open immersion, which identifies the source inside the product so that the given morphism becomes the restriction of the projection. The diagonal argument is the substance, so the claim is H2.
